steps.title: Access Reports

audioNote.markdown: There are four types of reports you can create and manage. Session reports display sessions vertically, with their associated details and relationships - such as speakers and moderators - organized horizontally across the report.

audioNote.markdown: Contact reports display contacts vertically, with their associated details and relationships - such as sessions - organized horizontally across the report.

audioNote.markdown: Evaluation Plan reports show the progress of each evaluator within their assigned plans. Admins cannot create additional Evaluation Plan reports. However, evaluator ratings and responses can be exported through the Evaluation module.

audioNote.markdown: To create a report, click Add Report next to the report type you want to generate.

steps.title: Add Report

audioNote.markdown: Within the pop-up, add a report name and provide a brief description that explains what the report includes.

steps.title: Configuration

audioNote.markdown: Enable the toggles to the right of the relationships you would like included within your report

steps.title: Configuration II

audioNote.markdown: Within the Choose Fields page of the report builder, you can select which fields to include in your report by toggling between the tabs below the search bar. Simply check the boxes next to the desired fields and they will appear in the right-hand panel as part of your report layout. Drag and drop fields on the left side to reorder their appearance.

audioNote.markdown: In the Filters & Sorting step, you can narrow down your report results by applying filters. You can also sort the data in ascending or descending order based on a specific field.
